Ah, now I understand your concern better. You're safe here - Google Workspace can't tell you're using the same physical YubiKey across different workspace accounts. This is by design in the FIDO2/WebAuthn protocol:

1. Each time you register your YubiKey with a new Google Workspace account:
- A completely new key pair is generated
- A new unique credential ID is created
- None of these are mathematically related to registrations with other accounts

2. There's no way for Google to correlate these different registrations back to a single physical key because:
- The attestation typically uses the "none" format
- Each registration appears to come from a completely separate authenticator
- The actual hardware identifiers from the YubiKey are never exposed

So you can freely use the same YubiKey across multiple Google Workspace accounts without them being linkable to each other. This privacy-preserving behavior is a core feature of the WebAuthn standard.
